messages:
tess: Quick heads-up small pricing experiment next week: add a micro 'Price Quicklook' widget on pricing, rename middle tier, and tweak FAQ microcopy. Goal = fewer Contact Sales clicks, more self-serve signups. Who can pick up copy, embed, analytics, and routing? omar: I can own analytics. Proposed events: pq_open, pq_submit, pq_estimate_usd, pq_contact_click. Prefixed in GA as rw_pq_*. Payload should include estimate_usd, tier_variant, utm_campaign, anonymous_id. Also send to BigQuery table marketing.price_quicklook_v1. jules: I'll build the tiny JS embed. Prototype: ```html
``` Will expose a callback that posts lead payload to /webhooks/pricing-leads. marco-sales: Routing rules: if estimate_usd >= 6000 OR user selects 'Enterprise interest' -> AE queue. Otherwise MQL. Add boolean field interested_enterprise and estimated_segment (self-serve / mid-market / enterprise). Also request a daily CSV export of leads during the experiment. nora-legal: Quick flag: avoid any copy that promises guaranteed uptime or pricing. Use: "Estimates are indicative; contact sales for firm quotes. Enterprise plans offer optional SLA-backed support." Approved. tess: Copy asks: change middle tier from 'Growth' -> 'Pro' for the experiment, and CTA variant 'See my price' vs baseline 'Get started'. Sam? (not in thread) omar: I'll wire GA4 + BigQuery mapping and add an alert if pq_contact_click increases >20% vs baseline. Event names locked as rw_pq_open, rw_pq_submit, rw_pq_value_usd, rw_pq_contact_click. jules: Timeline: widget to staging by Tue, QA Wed, experiment live Thu. I'll open PR and paste staging link here. deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-site/pull/2401 by jules tess: Thanks all. We'll run the A/B for 21 days and measure signup CTA conversion (primary) and Contact Sales clicks (secondary). If any telemetry spikes, ping #eng-oncall and I'll escalate. :rocket: deploy-bot: Staging build deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/price-quicklook (build-2026-10-02-018) tess: Closing thread DM me with questions. :tada:
